title: Gad fageenya Boollaa Irraa
intro: Imalli lubbuu dargaggeessa tokkoo mul’ata humna guddaa qabu qaamolee samii kabajaan jilbeenfataniin jalqabe. Jireenyi nama dhuunfaa kanaa warra itti dhihoo jiran irraa gantummaa gadi fagoo, itti aansee waggootaaf garbummaa fi hidhaa dogoggoraatiin kan mul’ate ture. Ta’us amantii hin raafamnee fi qajeelfama waaqaatiin, lakkoofsi kun boolla isa gadi aanaa irraa ka’ee namoota humna guddaa qaban impaayera guddaa tokko keessatti argaman keessaa tokko ta’e. Eenyummaa gabricha Rabbii dinqisiisaa kanaa saaxiluu dandeessaa?
clues: Mul’anni urjii kudha tokko, aduu fi ji’i na duratti sujuuda godhate natti agarsiifame
Ani mucaa warra koo baayʼee jaallatamu waanan tureef, obboloota koo biratti hinaaffaa uume
Obboloota kootiin qabamee, uffata koo irraa na irraa mulqee, boolla bishaanii gadi fagoo fi dukkanaaʼaa taʼetti na gatame
Bakka gabaa keessatti akka meeshaa gurgurtaatti gurguramee biyya koo irraa fagootti geeffama ture
Dubartiin humna guddaa qabdu tokko kabaja koo irratti araarama gochuuf kan yaalte siʼa taʼu, tarkaanfii ishee diduu kootiin mana hidhaatti darbatame
Kennaa abjuu hiikuutiin eebbifame, hidhamaa dagatame irraa gara ministeera muummee Gibxiitti ol ka'e

arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبْلُ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُم بِهِۦ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ رَسُولًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌۭ مُّرْتَابٌ
verse: And Joseph had already come to you before with clear proofs, but you remained in doubt of that which he brought to you, until when he died, you said, 'Never will Allāh send a messenger after him.' Thus does Allāh leave astray he who is a transgressor and skeptic." (40:34)
